en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 2.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) says, “Surah Anaam was revealed whole at once. Seventy thousand angels kept watch on it when  it  was  revealed  on  Muhammad  (s.a.w.s.).
Hence  it should  be  regarded  as  an  honored  Surah  and  must  be respected.  If  people  had  known  what  is  there  in  it  they would have never ignored it.”
